paper_title: Gas-rich dwarf galaxies as a new probe of dark matter interactions with ordinary matter
coupling_convention: dimensionless kinetic mixing chi (= g in paper)
notes: Paper derives new constraints on ultra-light hidden-photon (dark photon) DM kinetic mixing 'g' (= chi) from heating of gas in the Leo T dwarf galaxy, valid ~1e-23 to 1e-10 eV (Fig. 2). Coupling type is DarkPhoton (kinetic mixing), not VectorBL. The figure axis labels in the extracted text are corrupted/illegible, so the tabulated (mass, chi) points are APPROXIMATE estimates of the Leo T exclusion curve shape and magnitude (~1e-10 to 1e-9); actual digitized values are in the authors' GitHub data files (github.com/JayWadekar/Gas_rich_dwarfs). Paper also constrains millicharged DM (eps) and DM-nucleon cross sections, but those are not in the coupling enum. DM density is astrophysical (Leo T Burkert halo, spatially varying), not a standard local haloscope value, so dm_density_assumed left null. Astrophysical bound, no formal CL stated; conservative |Q_dot| <= |C_dot| requirement. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.4, 6))
